t: CAD Validation Engine - public implementations survey
title: CAD Validation Engine - public implementations survey
definition: Checks model structure and required design properties.
description:
This database surveys CAD Validation Engine as it exists in public practice: Checks model structure and required design properties. Nothing here is speculative - every implementation is a real project you can download, every technique is established practice.

Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.
